'''H2-FL''' was a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] that was employed by [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]], a genetic research facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. H2-FL worked on the surface section of the facility, receiving shipments of medical supplies and the like.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
H2-FL appears as a repair vendor at the start of the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access.<ref name="TOR" />
